tools.name: search_designs
tools.description: Search the InfySVG catalog of free SVG cut files by keyword. Returns matching designs with their page URLs. Each design page offers free SVG, PNG, DXF and PDF downloads plus recolouring, no account needed.

tools.name: get_design
tools.description: Full details for one design by its page slug (e.g. "royal-crown-121000019").

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every category and seasonal collection with design counts and page URLs.

tools.name: get_licence
tools.description: The licence terms for every design on InfySVG, in one paragraph.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_designs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the InfySVG catalog of free SVG cut files by keyword. Returns matching designs with their page URLs. Send the user to the page for downloads — every page offers free SVG, PNG, DXF and PDF plus recolouring, no account needed." → after: "Search the InfySVG catalog of free SVG cut files by keyword. Returns matching designs with their page URLs. Each design page offers free SVG, PNG, DXF and PDF downloads plus recolouring, no account needed."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
